T.title: Tokens-to-Token ViT: Training Vision Transformers from Scratch on ImageNet

lines.text: The T2T-ViT-7 and T2T-ViT-12 have similar model size with MobileNetV1 [17] and MobileNetV2 [32], but achieve comparable or higher performance than MobileNets (Tab. 4). For example, Our T2T-ViT-12 with 6.9M parameters achieves 76.5% top1 accuracy, which is higher than MobileNetsV21.4x by 0.9%. But we also note the MACs of our T2T-ViT are still larger than MobileNets because of the dense operations in Transformers. However, there are no special operations or tricks like efficient convolution [26, 32] in current T2T-ViT-7 and T2T-ViT-12, and we only reduce model size by reducing the hidden dimension, MLP ratio and depth of layers, indicating T2T-ViT is also very promising as a lite model. We also apply knowledge distillation on our T2T-ViT as the concurrent work DeiT [36] and find that our T2T-ViT-7 and T2T-ViT-12 can be further improved by distillation. Overall, the experimental results show, our T2T-ViT can achieve superior performance when it has mid-size as ResNets and reasonable results when it has a small model size as MobileNets.
Table 4: Comparison between our lite T2T-ViT with MobileNets. Models with ’-Distilled’ are taught by teacher model with the method as DeiT [36].

tasks.question: Extract DeiT B 224 and B 384 top-1 accuracy, first no-distillation row then class+distillation row. Return values in this order: no-distillation B224, no-distillation B384, class+distillation B224, class+distillation B384. Status extracted.
Compare DeiT no-distillation Ti224 with class+distillation Ti224. Require same paper, base-model variant, input resolution, and reported ImageNet top-1 metric. Return both values in that order.
Compare DeiT no-distillation Ti224 with class+distillation S224. Require identical base-model variant and input resolution, same paper and reported ImageNet top-1 metric. Return both values.
Compare DeiT no-distillation B224 with class+distillation B384. Require identical base-model variant and input resolution, same paper and reported ImageNet top-1 metric. Return both values.

Compare DeiT no-distillation Ti224 with class+distillation Ti224. Require same base variant, input resolution, metric, AND documented identical training GPU hardware. Return both values. Use only the supplied excerpt.

Compare T2T-ViT-7 and T2T-ViT-7-Distilled reported top-1 accuracy in Table 4. Require the same base model before distillation, same paper and reported metric; distillation is the contrast. No claim about unreported training controls or causation. Return both values.

limitations: Six tasks drawn from two already-used papers; expected answers source-checked by the coding assistant, not independently labeled.
Single stochastic request per model; no statistical inference or general model ranking.
ReferencesExist checks identifier validity, not entailment; read each explanation and source.
Diagnostic uses a compact fixed prompt, not the full Relay pipeline. Latency includes network and may reflect concurrent service load.

explanationReview.reviewer: coding assistant, not independent human expert
explanationReview.finding: Nano variant_conflict returns the correct incompatible label but incorrectly attributes it to resolution. Ti224 and S224 have the same 224 resolution and different base-model variants. Super and GPT-OSS identify the base-variant conflict correctly.
explanationReview.citationLimit: All cited IDs exist, but Nano and GPT-OSS omit header references throughout; Super includes column headings but does not consistently cite all outcome/context headings. Identifier validity is not complete citation support.
explanationReview.conclusion: Do not describe six correct labels as six fully validated scientific answers. This diagnostic does not establish full-workflow accuracy or an optimal model.
